1. (Judgment 5) The 15th Club deck reads "A round's worth of decisions, modeled: strokes-gained, shot dispersion and course strategy — the stuff a scorecard was never built to hold." The records describe 15th Club differently: "A platform for AI experiments through the lens of golf. The scorecard is the first experiment — shareable, real-time, no app install required. More experiments to follow." Nothing in the records mentions strokes-gained, shot dispersion or course-strategy modelling. Replace the deck with the records' description.

2. (Judgment 5) At 360, the "CLIENTS & COLLABORATORS" logo wall (Rolex, Intuit, LastPass, bswift, RTIC, Publicis Sapient, Framebridge) sits directly under the 15th Club artifact and deck. That placement presents them as 15th Club clients. The records list them only as Spaceman clients. Label the wall as Spaceman's clients or move it beside the Spaceman row, at both widths.

3. (Judgment 5) The footer colophon gives Doug's role as "Designer & engineer." The record's role is "Product Designer & Developer." Use the recorded role.

1. Freshness: the page reads as a rerun of 2026-11-21 ("Three tied at nine under"). Both are two-asymmetric with a footer-only shell, both use a green near 152–162° against a dark-void ground, and both set the hero right-aligned and stacked. The 2026-11-14 artifact page (teal 170 on dark-void, diagonal, right-weighted, footer-only, right-aligned) is also close. Break at least two of these shared traits so a returning visitor can't mistake it for either night.

2. Freshness, and the brief's own colour spec: the brief asks for a near-black pine ground with spruce green only as "the single green flood at the foot". The mockup instead floods the whole artifact column with mid-green at 1440 and the entire first fold at 360. Return the hero field to the #0A140F dark ground and keep the saturated green for the colophon. That restores the declared single saturated beat.

3. Judgment 4: at 360 a "Spaceman · clients & partners" logo band sits between the artifact and the selected-work index. The Mobile Declaration's order is artifact, deck, selected-work index, site callout, signal rail, footer. Either remove the band or move it so the zones run in the declared order.

1. **Freshness.** This reads as a rerun of 2026-11-14 ("a product spec plate, the work reversed out of a teal-black…"). That night also put a 170° teal on a dark-void ground, with a diagonal, right-weighted, footer-only, type-dominant artifact layout set lowercase and right-aligned. Tonight's 162° spruce sits 8° from it on the same ground, in the same silhouette and alignment. It also echoes 2026-11-21 (152° fairway green, dark-void, two-asymmetric, footer-only, right/stacked). Move the ground off dark-void or the hue well off the green-teal band, so the didone italic is not the only thing a returning visitor sees as new.

2. **Legibility.** On the phone in fold 1, the "CAP-HEIGHT" annotation collides with the glyphs of "15th" and "BASELINE" collides with "Club", so the specimen labels and the product title overprint each other. At 360, either drop the annotations or set them clear of the title, above and below it.

3. **Hierarchy.** On the phone, the type-specimen furniture competes with the artifact: the "dm serif display · optical size 150 · x-height 0.71" line in fold 1, and the "SPRUCE 162° THE SINGLE INK" swatch block in fold 2. Neither is in the Mobile Declaration's `order`, and both push the selected-work index down. Cut both at 360, or demote them, so the sequence runs title, caption, deck, index.
